Hello,
the first connector on our charger 313882469001 was faulted this morning and probably the whole weekend.
I did a restart and after that the connector was in the State "available" again.
But over this past weekend there were over 2470 sent to our backend, probably because of the state of the first connector.
in the screenshot you can see that these error messages were sent nearly every minute until I restarted the charger at 10:22.
We would kindly ask you to check why this keeps happening, as this has happened with connector 2 on this charger not that long ago (see case "ID0471365-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/S9 313882469001] Connector 2 faulted and multiple errors")
Thank you and kind regards.

additional_info.subject: ID0475841-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2 / S9 313882469001] Faulted Socket CRM:03289000427
additional_info.body:
Hello Lara, good morning.
I checked the logs from the past 4 days, after the error was no longer present, which was resolved with the reboot, and I cannot find another occurrence.
The R&D team has been assigned the task of finding the root cause and provide a solution so that this does not rehappen in the future.
For now, we will close this ticket since there is nothing to be done from Technical Support side.
Please keep opening tickets if this happens in order to have more evidence. I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you very much and have a lovely weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
